text: Changing my review as the problem has been fixed by Liam, and everything is working back as it should be again. My only hang-up with this app is that it will often change what you are saying when you want it to say exactly what you've said, word for word. Also, there doesn't seem to be a way of correcting spellings on the app: when I try to use the button to make corrections, it just writes as if I am talking to it Like normal.
